scale.meaning: 0-2 unusable/unrelated; 3-4 major style failures; 5-6 recognizable but materially wrong; 7 close but revision required; 8 faithful and production-acceptable; 9 excellent detailed match; 10 exceptional, no observable mismatch

criteria.description: Match reference cut density, shot-duration pattern, acceleration, holds, hook rhythm and section energy. Judge style against the actual reference even if the plan drifted.
critical_failure_conditions: Wrong or uninspected reference/render; fabricated evidence; missing required segment; plan substitution hides a style mismatch.

anchors.0: Absent, unusable or unrelated to the reference and plan.
anchors.4: Repeated major discrepancies; substantial re-edit needed.
anchors.6: Recognizable approach but material timing, execution or style defects.
anchors.7: Close to target but visible discrepancies still require correction.
anchors.8: Matches reference style and plan; no material discrepancies.
anchors.9: Precise, coherent match with only negligible differences.
anchors.10: Exceptional match in every observed detail; must cite specific evidence.
